class.name: ArrayTexture
class.brief_description: A texture that displays one layer of a 2D texture array.
class.description: A [Texture2D] resource that displays the selected [member layer] of a [member texture_array]. Multiple [ArrayTexture] resources can reference layers of the same 2D texture array without duplicating its texture data or mipmaps. [b]Note:[/b] [ArrayTexture] is supported by the Forward+ and Mobile rendering methods. The Compatibility rendering method displays a placeholder instead.

members.member: The zero-based index of the layer to display. If the index is outside the range of the [member texture_array], a placeholder is displayed until the array contains that layer.
The 2D texture array containing the selected [member layer]. Can be a [Texture2DArray], [CompressedTexture2DArray], or [Texture2DArrayRD]. Cubemaps and cubemap arrays are not supported.
